minecraft:weathered_cut_copper_slab: A cut copper slab that is mostly oxidized. Wax it with honeycomb to keep this look. An axe scrapes it back one stage.
minecraft:oxidized_cut_copper_slab: A cut copper slab fully oxidized to teal. It no longer changes on its own. An axe or lightning can restore its shine.
minecraft:waxed_copper_block: A copper block sealed with honeycomb. Wax stops it from oxidizing, so it stays bright orange forever. Scrape the wax off with an axe if you want it to age again.
minecraft:waxed_exposed_copper: Exposed copper sealed with honeycomb. The wax locks in its first patches of oxidation. An axe removes the wax.
minecraft:waxed_weathered_copper: Weathered copper sealed with honeycomb. The wax keeps its mostly green look from changing. An axe removes the wax.
minecraft:waxed_oxidized_copper: Fully oxidized copper sealed with honeycomb. The wax keeps its teal patina exactly as it is. An axe removes the wax.
minecraft:waxed_chiseled_copper: Chiseled copper sealed with honeycomb. It keeps its fresh orange shine. An axe removes the wax.
minecraft:waxed_exposed_chiseled_copper: Exposed chiseled copper sealed with honeycomb. Its look is frozen at the first stage of oxidation. An axe removes the wax.
minecraft:waxed_weathered_chiseled_coppe: Weathered chiseled copper sealed with honeycomb. Its mostly green look won't change. An axe removes the wax.
minecraft:waxed_oxidized_chiseled_copper: Oxidized chiseled copper sealed with honeycomb. Its teal patina is locked in place. An axe removes the wax.
minecraft:waxed_cut_copper: Cut copper sealed with honeycomb. It stays bright and never oxidizes. An axe removes the wax.
minecraft:waxed_exposed_cut_copper: Exposed cut copper sealed with honeycomb. Its look is frozen at the first stage of oxidation. An axe removes the wax.
minecraft:waxed_weathered_cut_copper: Weathered cut copper sealed with honeycomb. Its mostly green look won't change. An axe removes the wax.
minecraft:waxed_oxidized_cut_copper: Oxidized cut copper sealed with honeycomb. Its teal patina is locked in place. An axe removes the wax.
minecraft:waxed_cut_copper_stairs: Cut copper stairs sealed with honeycomb. They keep their fresh shine. An axe removes the wax.
minecraft:waxed_exposed_cut_copper_stair: Exposed cut copper stairs sealed with honeycomb. Their look won't change further. An axe removes the wax.
minecraft:waxed_weathered_cut_copper_sta: Weathered cut copper stairs sealed with honeycomb. Their mostly green look is locked in. An axe removes the wax.
minecraft:waxed_oxidized_cut_copper_stai: Oxidized cut copper stairs sealed with honeycomb. Their teal patina is locked in place. An axe removes the wax.
minecraft:waxed_cut_copper_slab: A cut copper slab sealed with honeycomb. It keeps its fresh shine. An axe removes the wax.
minecraft:waxed_exposed_cut_copper_slab: An exposed cut copper slab sealed with honeycomb. Its look won't change further. An axe removes the wax.
minecraft:waxed_weathered_cut_copper_sla: A weathered cut copper slab sealed with honeycomb. Its mostly green look is locked in. An axe removes the wax.
minecraft:waxed_oxidized_cut_copper_slab: An oxidized cut copper slab sealed with honeycomb. Its teal patina is locked in place. An axe removes the wax.
minecraft:oak_log: The trunk of an oak tree and the first thing most players collect. Each log crafts into four oak planks. Smelt it for charcoal, or strip it with an axe.
minecraft:spruce_log: The dark trunk of a spruce tree from taigas and snowy forests. Each log crafts into four spruce planks. It can be stripped with an axe or smelted into charcoal.
minecraft:birch_log: The white, spotted trunk of a birch tree. Each log crafts into four birch planks. It can be stripped with an axe or smelted into charcoal.
minecraft:jungle_log: The trunk of a jungle tree, often covered in vines. Cocoa beans grow only on jungle logs. Each log crafts into four jungle planks.
minecraft:acacia_log: The grey trunk of an acacia tree from savannas. Each log crafts into four orange acacia planks. It can be stripped with an axe or smelted into charcoal.
minecraft:cherry_log: The dark, pink-hearted trunk of a cherry tree. Each log crafts into four cherry planks. It can be stripped with an axe or smelted into charcoal.
minecraft:dark_oak_log: The thick trunk of a dark oak from dark forests. Each log crafts into four dark oak planks. It can be stripped with an axe or smelted into charcoal.
minecraft:mangrove_log: The trunk of a mangrove tree from mangrove swamps. Each log crafts into four mangrove planks. It can be stripped with an axe or smelted into charcoal.
minecraft:mangrove_roots: The tangled roots at the base of mangrove trees. You can see through them, and they can hold water. Combine them with mud for muddy mangrove roots.
minecraft:muddy_mangrove_roots: Mangrove roots packed with mud, found under mangrove trees. Craft them from mangrove roots and mud. They are a natural-looking decorative block.
minecraft:crimson_stem: The stem of a huge crimson fungus from the Nether. It works like a log and crafts into four crimson planks. Nether wood never burns.
minecraft:warped_stem: The stem of a huge warped fungus from the Nether. It works like a log and crafts into four warped planks. Nether wood never burns.
minecraft:bamboo_block: Nine bamboo stalks bundled into a block. It crafts into two bamboo planks. Strip it with an axe for a smoother look.
minecraft:stripped_oak_log: An oak log with its bark removed by an axe. It still crafts into four planks. Builders use it for clean, light beams.
minecraft:stripped_spruce_log: A spruce log with its bark removed by an axe. It still crafts into four planks. Its warm brown grain suits cabins and beams.
minecraft:stripped_birch_log: A birch log with its bark removed by an axe. It still crafts into four planks. It gives a pale, smooth beam.
minecraft:stripped_jungle_log: A jungle log with its bark removed by an axe. It still crafts into four planks. It makes a warm, reddish beam.
minecraft:stripped_acacia_log: An acacia log with its bark removed by an axe. It still crafts into four planks. Its bright orange surface stands out in builds.
minecraft:stripped_cherry_log: A cherry log with its bark removed by an axe. It still crafts into four planks. It reveals a soft pink grain.
minecraft:stripped_dark_oak_log: A dark oak log with its bark removed by an axe. It still crafts into four planks. It makes a deep brown beam.
minecraft:stripped_mangrove_log: A mangrove log with its bark removed by an axe. It still crafts into four planks. It reveals a rich red grain.
minecraft:stripped_crimson_stem: A crimson stem with its outer layer removed by an axe. It still crafts into four planks. Like all Nether wood, it never burns.
minecraft:stripped_warped_stem: A warped stem with its outer layer removed by an axe. It still crafts into four planks. Like all Nether wood, it never burns.
minecraft:stripped_oak_wood: Oak wood with the bark stripped off on every side. Strip oak wood with an axe, or craft four stripped logs into three. It is a smooth, all-sided building block.
minecraft:stripped_spruce_wood: Spruce wood stripped on every side. Strip spruce wood with an axe, or craft four stripped logs into three. It shows the same grain on all faces.
minecraft:stripped_birch_wood: Birch wood stripped on every side. Strip birch wood with an axe, or craft four stripped logs into three. It is a pale, uniform building block.
minecraft:stripped_jungle_wood: Jungle wood stripped on every side. Strip jungle wood with an axe, or craft four stripped logs into three. It is a warm, uniform building block.
minecraft:stripped_acacia_wood: Acacia wood stripped on every side. Strip acacia wood with an axe, or craft four stripped logs into three. It is bright orange on every face.
minecraft:stripped_cherry_wood: Cherry wood stripped on every side. Strip cherry wood with an axe, or craft four stripped logs into three. It is pink on every face.
minecraft:stripped_dark_oak_wood: Dark oak wood stripped on every side. Strip dark oak wood with an axe, or craft four stripped logs into three. It is deep brown on every face.
minecraft:stripped_mangrove_wood: Mangrove wood stripped on every side. Strip mangrove wood with an axe, or craft four stripped logs into three. It is red on every face.
minecraft:stripped_crimson_hyphae: Crimson hyphae stripped on every side. Strip hyphae with an axe, or craft four stripped stems into three. It never burns.
minecraft:stripped_warped_hyphae: Warped hyphae stripped on every side. Strip hyphae with an axe, or craft four stripped stems into three. It never burns.
minecraft:stripped_bamboo_block: A block of bamboo with its outer layer stripped by an axe. It crafts into two bamboo planks. It has a smoother, paler look.
minecraft:oak_wood: Oak bark on all six sides, with no ring pattern on the ends. Craft four oak logs into three. It crafts into four planks like a log.
minecraft:spruce_wood: Spruce bark on all six sides. Craft four spruce logs into three. It crafts into four planks like a log.
minecraft:birch_wood: White birch bark on all six sides. Craft four birch logs into three. It crafts into four planks like a log.
minecraft:jungle_wood: Jungle bark on all six sides. Craft four jungle logs into three. It crafts into four planks like a log.
minecraft:acacia_wood: Grey acacia bark on all six sides. Craft four acacia logs into three. It crafts into four planks like a log.
minecraft:cherry_wood: Dark cherry bark on all six sides. Craft four cherry logs into three. It crafts into four planks like a log.
minecraft:dark_oak_wood: Dark oak bark on all six sides. Craft four dark oak logs into three. It crafts into four planks like a log.
minecraft:mangrove_wood: Mangrove bark on all six sides. Craft four mangrove logs into three. It crafts into four planks like a log.
minecraft:crimson_hyphae: Crimson stem texture on all six sides. Craft four crimson stems into three. Like all Nether wood, it never burns.
minecraft:warped_hyphae: Warped stem texture on all six sides. Craft four warped stems into three. Like all Nether wood, it never burns.
minecraft:oak_leaves: The leaves of an oak tree. They decay when no log is nearby, dropping saplings, sticks and sometimes apples. Collect them with shears.
minecraft:spruce_leaves: The needles of a spruce tree. They decay when no log is nearby, dropping saplings and sticks. Collect them with shears.
minecraft:birch_leaves: The light leaves of a birch tree. They decay when no log is nearby, dropping saplings and sticks. Collect them with shears.
minecraft:jungle_leaves: The dense leaves of a jungle tree. They decay when no log is nearby, dropping saplings and sticks. Collect them with shears.
minecraft:acacia_leaves: The leaves of an acacia tree. They decay when no log is nearby, dropping saplings and sticks. Collect them with shears.
minecraft:cherry_leaves: The pink blossoms of a cherry tree, which drift petals as they fall. They decay when no log is nearby, dropping saplings and sticks. Collect them with shears.
minecraft:dark_oak_leaves: The leaves of a dark oak tree. They decay when no log is nearby, dropping saplings, sticks and sometimes apples. Collect them with shears.
minecraft:mangrove_leaves: The leaves of a mangrove tree, where propagules hang. They decay when no log is nearby, dropping sticks. Collect them with shears.
minecraft:azalea_leaves: The leaves of an azalea tree, found above lush caves. They drop azalea bushes and sticks as they decay. Collect them with shears.
minecraft:flowering_azalea_leaves: Azalea leaves dotted with pink flowers. They drop flowering azalea bushes and sticks as they decay. Collect them with shears.
minecraft:sponge: A dry sponge that soaks up water around it when placed. It then turns into a wet sponge. Sponges come from ocean monuments and elder guardians.
minecraft:wet_sponge: A sponge full of water. Dry it in a furnace to use it again, or place it in the Nether to dry it instantly. While wet, it drips water from its underside.
minecraft:glass: A clear block made by smelting sand. It breaks without Silk Touch, so handle it carefully. Craft it into panes, bottles or stained glass.
minecraft:tinted_glass: Dark glass that blocks light but lets you see through. Craft it from glass and amethyst shards. Unlike glass, it drops itself when broken.
minecraft:lapis_block: Nine lapis lazuli packed into a block. It stores lapis compactly. It is purely decorative beyond that.
minecraft:sandstone: A soft stone made from four sand, also found under deserts and beaches. It can be cut, chiseled or smoothed. Desert villages and temples are built from it.
minecraft:chiseled_sandstone: Sandstone carved with a creeper-like pattern, seen in desert pyramids. Craft it from two sandstone slabs stacked. A stonecutter works too.
minecraft:cut_sandstone: Sandstone cut into a clean, banded block. Craft four sandstone into four cut sandstone, or use a stonecutter. It has its own slabs.
minecraft:cobweb: A sticky web found in mineshafts, strongholds and trial chambers. Anything caught in it moves very slowly. A sword breaks it quickly and drops string; shears collect the web itself.
minecraft:short_grass: Short tufts of grass covering most grassland. Breaking it sometimes drops wheat seeds. Collect it with shears, or use bone meal to grow tall grass.
minecraft:fern: A small fern common in taigas and jungles. It sometimes drops wheat seeds. Collect it with shears, or use bone meal to grow a large fern.
minecraft:azalea: A small round shrub found above lush caves. Bone meal grows it into an azalea tree with rooted dirt below. It can also go in a flower pot.
minecraft:flowering_azalea: An azalea shrub covered in pink flowers. Bone meal grows it into a flowering azalea tree. It looks lovely in a flower pot.
minecraft:dead_bush: A dry shrub found in deserts and badlands. Breaking it drops sticks. Collect it with shears to plant elsewhere.
minecraft:seagrass: Grass that grows on the ocean floor. Collect it with shears. Bone meal underwater spreads it and grows tall seagrass.
minecraft:sea_pickle: A small glowing creature found in warm ocean reefs. Up to four fit in one block, glowing brighter the more there are, but only under water. Smelt it into lime dye.
minecraft:white_wool: Soft wool sheared from white sheep or crafted from four string. It can be dyed any color. Wool makes beds, carpets and banners, and it muffles vibrations for sculk sensors.
minecraft:orange_wool: Wool dyed orange, from orange sheep or by dyeing wool. It makes orange beds, carpets and banners. Like all wool, it muffles vibrations.
minecraft:magenta_wool: Wool dyed magenta, from magenta sheep or by dyeing wool. It makes magenta beds, carpets and banners. Like all wool, it muffles vibrations.
minecraft:light_blue_wool: Wool dyed light blue, from light blue sheep or by dyeing wool. It makes light blue beds, carpets and banners. Like all wool, it muffles vibrations.
minecraft:yellow_wool: Wool dyed yellow, from yellow sheep or by dyeing wool. It makes yellow beds, carpets and banners. Like all wool, it muffles vibrations.
minecraft:lime_wool: Wool dyed lime, from lime sheep or by dyeing wool. It makes lime beds, carpets and banners. Like all wool, it muffles vibrations.
minecraft:pink_wool: Wool dyed pink, from pink sheep or by dyeing wool. Pink sheep are rare in the wild. Like all wool, it muffles vibrations.
minecraft:gray_wool: Wool dyed gray, often sheared from naturally gray sheep. It makes gray beds, carpets and banners. Like all wool, it muffles vibrations.
minecraft:light_gray_wool: Wool dyed light gray, often sheared from naturally light gray sheep. It makes light gray beds, carpets and banners. Like all wool, it muffles vibrations.
minecraft:cyan_wool: Wool dyed cyan, from cyan sheep or by dyeing wool. It makes cyan beds, carpets and banners. Like all wool, it muffles vibrations.
minecraft:purple_wool: Wool dyed purple, from purple sheep or by dyeing wool. It makes purple beds, carpets and banners. Like all wool, it muffles vibrations.
minecraft:blue_wool: Wool dyed blue, from blue sheep or by dyeing wool. It makes blue beds, carpets and banners. Like all wool, it muffles vibrations.
minecraft:brown_wool: Wool dyed brown, often sheared from naturally brown sheep. It makes brown beds, carpets and banners. Like all wool, it muffles vibrations.
minecraft:green_wool: Wool dyed green, from green sheep or by dyeing wool. It makes green beds, carpets and banners. Like all wool, it muffles vibrations.
minecraft:red_wool: Wool dyed red, from red sheep or by dyeing wool. It makes red beds, carpets and banners. Like all wool, it muffles vibrations.
minecraft:black_wool: Wool dyed black, often sheared from naturally black sheep. It makes black beds, carpets and banners. Like all wool, it muffles vibrations.
minecraft:dandelion: A cheerful yellow flower common in plains. Craft it into yellow dye. Bees love it, and it can be fed to rabbits.
minecraft:poppy: A bright red flower found almost everywhere grass grows. Craft it into red dye. Iron golems sometimes offer one to villagers.
minecraft:blue_orchid: A light blue flower that grows only in swamps. Craft it into light blue dye. In a suspicious stew it gives saturation.
minecraft:allium: A round purple flower found in flower forests. Craft it into magenta dye. In a suspicious stew it grants fire resistance.
